section_summary.extract_value: This section concludes that the present study was the first to explore the relationship between external shame and body appreciation, finding that self-compassion mediates this relationship. The findings suggest important research and intervention implications, emphasizing self-compassion as a health-promoting tool and supporting its targeting in prevention programs for body image-related disorders. The text refers to a single study.
